// Fixture: query builders and ORMs other than Relica, in files without
// Relica. Their Select/OrderBy/Update/Delete follow their own rules, so the
// Relica-specific checks must skip these files.
package legacy

import (
	sq "github.com/Masterminds/squirrel"
	"github.com/uptrace/bun"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

func squirrelList() {
	sq.Select("1").From("t").OrderBy("created_at DESC, id").GroupBy("a, b")
	sq.Delete("sessions").RunWith(nil).Exec()
}

func gormList(db *gorm.DB) {
	db.Select("1").Order("a DESC, b").Find(nil)
}

func bunList(db *bun.DB) {
	db.NewSelect().Table("t").OrderExpr("a DESC, b")
}
